references.observed: Broad, light rock-fill downstream faces meet at a pronounced curve, with a thin dark crest road and irregular rock toes. Reservoir upstream of both faces.
Separate concrete main spillway with tapered triangular buttresses, dark gate openings, a curved ogee chute, flared retaining banks and a fenced tailwater walkway.

Oblique crest view shows the drop into the broad stilling pool, two flared structural walls, the concrete baffle geometry and the long downstream channel. Pale rock-fill slopes stand to the left downstream. This is a visual control on the relative layout, not a georeferenced image.
